previous_description: Complete UX specification for a single experience (visual, voice, chat, SMS)
definition: A specification artifact that groups the routable views and top-level experience states making up one user experience (a feature area or user journey) delivered in a single modality: visual, voice, chat or SMS. It is aggregated by a UXApplication and is the unit that satisfies UX requirements.

distinguish_from.when: the element groups several experiences and carries application-wide settings such as theme, design system, default locale or target channel.
the element is a single routable screen, page, modal or dialog rather than the collection of screens and states for a whole experience.
the state machine is a reusable template (wizard, optimistic-update, tab-panel) meant to be applied across experiences rather than the top-level states of one concrete experience.
the element is a shareable package of library components, sub-views and patterns with no routes or experience-specific states of its own.

code_evidence: A feature module or route-group directory (e.g. Angular module calling RouterModule.forChild, Next.js app/(checkout)/ group, React Router nested route tree) that bundles the routes and screens of one user journey.
A top-level flow state machine (e.g. XState createMachine or a Redux slice for a flow) whose states correspond to the screens or steps of a single experience such as onboarding or checkout.

A per-experience design or interaction artifact: a Figma page or Storybook section named for a journey, or for non-visual modalities a voice skill interaction model (Alexa/Dialogflow JSON) or chatbot flow definition.

attribute_descriptions.name: version
attribute_descriptions.description: Version identifier of this experience specification, preferably semantic versioning (e.g. '1.2.0'); set it when the spec is released or revised independently of the application.

attribute_descriptions.name: title
attribute_descriptions.description: Human-readable name of the experience (e.g. 'Checkout', 'Account Onboarding') used in documentation and diagrams; set it on every spec.

attribute_descriptions.name: description
attribute_descriptions.description: Free-text summary of the user goal and scope this experience covers, including which journeys are in or out of scope; set it whenever the title alone does not make the boundary clear.

notes: The experience enum (visual|voice|chat|sms) does not align with the channel enum (web|mobile|voice|chat|sms) used by UXApplication, ActionComponent and ExperienceState; 'visual' conflates web and mobile. Granularity is undefined: 'complete' should be replaced by a rule (one per journey or feature). The governs→errorconfig relationship has no matching attribute.
